Step 3 was approved by the user on 2026-10-30. HARD RULES: run COMMAND 1 EXACTLY ONCE (then only poll with COMMAND 1b). cd /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge && export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp && (set -a; . ./.env; set +a; unset OPENAI_API_KEY RAILWAY_TOKEN RAILWAY_PROJECT_ID FREYTAG_TEST_CLOCK_TOKEN; setsid nohup bash scripts/ringer/environment_narration/enforce_t9h_opening_check.sh smoke > /tmp/opening-check-smoke.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & echo $! > /tmp/opening-check-smoke.pid)

COMMAND 1b (poll; repeat it, one call at a time, until it prints DONE; each call waits at most 40 seconds; do NOT run COMMAND 1 again):
for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do if kill -0 $(cat /tmp/opening-check-smoke.pid) 2>/dev/null; then sleep 5; else echo DONE; break; fi; done; echo still-running-or-done; tail -c 700 /tmp/opening-check-smoke.log

When it prints DONE, report only the non-secret tail of the log and each route's exit and stop reason. Do not interpret quality.
